messages:
Maria (eng-platform): Heads-up — we need to lock the telemetry ingest contract for degraded-mode and fallback counts so console/dashboard can ship the reliability panels this sprint. Who's free to align?
Kevin (eng-runtime): I can take the runtime side. Proposal: metric name runtime.fallbacks.count with tags = {route_id, tier, fallback_reason, model_variant, rollout_id, region}. Counter increments on each fallback.
Sam (console): Console needs 1m & 5m rollups and ability to pivot by rollout_id and route_id. Also want a dedicated time-series for p95 fallback latency.
Lucy (sre): From ops: we need a separate signal for degraded-mode enters/exits to avoid double-counting. Suggest runtime.degraded.enter (counter) and runtime.degraded.exit (counter) + runtime.degraded.duration_ms as histogram.
Priya (product): Product asks to filter by customer_tier and have a canary view (rollout_id) so PMs can see degradations during rollouts.
Maria (eng-platform): Draft contract idea:
```
# metrics (v1)
- runtime.fallbacks.count: counter
  tags: [route_id, tier, fallback_reason, model_variant, rollout_id, region, error_class]
- runtime.degraded.enter: counter
- runtime.degraded.exit: counter
- runtime.degraded.duration_ms: histogram (or precomputed p50/p95 tags)
- runtime.request.errors: counter tags [route_id, error_class]
```
Kevin (eng-runtime): Histogram is heavy for ingest. Runtime can emit precomputed percentiles per 1m window as gauges, e.g. runtime.fallback.latency.p95{route_id,rollout_id}=123. That keeps ES and TSDB costs down.
Sam (console): Gauges for p50/p95 work for dashboarding. We still want raw counter for counts. For rollups: console will compute 5m from 1m windows.
Lucy (sre): For classification: use error_class in {timeout, 5xx, oom, model_fallback, routing_quota}. That lets alert rules target oom/timeout spikes separately.
Kevin (eng-runtime): Agree. Implementation notes: runtime will emit counter increments with fallback_reason and error_class. We'll add a lightweight exporter to emit p50/p95 per 60s when latency samples > 10.
Maria (eng-platform): Ops-bot: deploy plan? ops-bot: New PR pipeline created for observability spec: https://ci.internal/redwood/obs-contracts/pulls/42 :white_check_mark:
Sam (console): For dashboard panels, example queries we'd use: 
- Total fallbacks (1m): sum by(route_id, rollout_id) (rate(runtime.fallbacks.count[1m]))
- Fallback p95: max(runtime.fallback.latency.p95) group by route_id
- Degraded mode rate: increase(runtime.degraded.enter[5m]) / increase(runtime.request.count[5m])
(We can refine PromQL once keys land)
Priya (product): Can we add rollout_id in logs linkback so PM can click to rollout page from a spike?
Maria (eng-platform): Yes — add rollout_id as tag to logs and traces. We'll include that in spec.
Kevin (eng-runtime): Action items: I will: 1) open runtime PR to emit counters+p95 gauges (eta EOD Wed), 2) add README for tag semantics.
Sam (console): I will: 1) stub dashboard panels using mock metrics, 2) wire filtering by rollout_id and tier (eta Thu).
Lucy (sre): I will: 1) draft alert rules for oom/timeouts and fallback surge, 2) confirm cardinality impact (eta Thu).
Maria (eng-platform): I'll own the spec doc and coordinate merge: /observability/ingest_contracts/fallbacks_degraded_v1.yaml. Targeting rollout to staging next Tue.
Priya (product): I'll provide the list of priority routes and recent rollout IDs for testing.
Kevin (eng-runtime): One more note: please avoid free-form strings for rollout_id at source — use normalized IDs (rl_1234). I'll enforce in schema.
Sam (console): Sounds good. If y'all ok, I'll start with the mock panels and post screenshots here when done. :thumbsup:
Maria (eng-platform): Thanks everyone. If no objections by EOD I'll merge the spec and tag implementers.
ops-bot: Reminder: next observability sync Tue 10am — agenda: rollout telemetry validation.
